blocks.content: Compose reads a .env file next to the compose file for interpolation, and will merge compose.override.yaml on top automatically. That is how one definition serves both local work and CI.

docker compose up -d --build
docker compose logs -f api
docker compose down -v        # -v also removes the volumes

blocks.title: down -v deletes your data
blocks.content: The -v flag removes named volumes, which on a local stack means the database contents. Leave it off unless you want a clean slate.
